messages.content: London's central zones like Soho and majority of the Tube stops are safe, while specific alleys in East London or "black spots" in West London should be avoided at night. Similarly, NYC is generally safe during the day but known for aggressive pickpocketing in tourist markets like Times Square, whereas areas like the Lower East Side and Central Park's Lake Shore Drive can warrant extra vigilance after dark. Packing a noise-making alarm and staying in well-lit areas will significantly boost your safety during your solo trip. Simply sticking to main venues and avoiding isolated shortcuts will keep you secure in both cities.
